output.content:
The comparison is saved. Glucose in CHO-004-R01 vs CHO-004-R02, differences defined as CHO-004-R02 minus CHO-004-R01, at exactly matched elapsed sample times (0.0 tolerance), from the Northfield October delivery:

**Result (11 matched times, 0.0–142.0 h elapsed):**
- **Mean signed difference: −0.239 g/L** (CHO-004-R02 lower on average; median −0.242 g/L, standard deviation 0.324 g/L).
- **Largest absolute difference: 0.944 g/L at 19.5 h elapsed** — CHO-004-R01 at 7.133 g/L vs CHO-004-R02 at 6.189 g/L, R02 the lower.
- 11 of 12 CHO-004-R01 samples matched: its final 164.0 h sample (0.124 g/L) has no counterpart because CHO-004-R02 ends at 142.0 h.
- Both batches trend down in parallel from ~7 g/L at inoculation to <0.4 g/L at 142 h; the largest gap is early, at the 19.5 h peak sample.

This is a descriptive comparison only — no significance test (successive samples of one run are not independent), and batch context (product, process version, equipment, scale, stage) is not recorded, so the difference cannot be attributed to specific conditions.

**Deliveries still in review (all values provisional and unreviewed — read from the delivery files, not yet checked; verify before relying on them):**
- Northfield Biologics · October runs (CHO-004-R01/R02, CHO-005-R01/R02, CHO-006-R01/R02) — this comparison drew on it; it carries 55 open review checks.
- Northfield Biologics · November runs (CHO-007-R01/R02, CHO-008-R01/R02, CHO-009-R01/R02) — not used here.
- Harborview CDMO · fed-batch runs (CHO-010-R01/R02, CHO-011-R01/R02, CHO-012-R01/R02) — not used here.
